correctness.rationale: The Crofton offset gap formula is derived in the intrinsic affine space and the Gaussian direction/radius reduction cancels the random norm. The binomial integral follows by Tonelli on order-statistic gaps. The exact expectation follows from pairwise Gaussian distances. Gaussian extremes, Gaussian Mills bounds, Scheffe density convergence and uniform conditional binomial Chernoff bounds establish the nondegenerate limit. All normalizations and endpoint negligible cases are stated in RESULT.md; extracted standalone verify.py passes six finite quadrature identities and seeded Monte Carlo cross-checks. Finite evidence is explicitly not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural invariant affine Crofton sampling of a regular simplex has a complete exact Gaussian-integral section-face law for every dimension and a nondegenerate continuously distributed logarithmic face-count exponent. Its normalized face count vanishes in probability despite its large expected value, a strong structural contrast with central sections. This is a motivated stochastic-geometry invariant with broad dimension-dependent implications, not an arbitrary finite numeric slice or renaming.
